title: MPS: the test login's secret has been expired for a week. Who renews it?
bluf: The test login that the demo loader and three after-deploy checks use has had an expired secret since 12 November. You twice chose to deploy without those checks and to renew it as a separate task. Nobody has been asked to do it. Renewing it is a step in the Microsoft Entra portal and it is yours, or that of someone you name. We cannot do it from here. Who does it, and when?

options.label: I will renew it myself
options.detail: Your step, in the Microsoft Entra portal: open the test login's app registration, add a new client secret, copy the new value once, and give it to the deploy seat or put it where the demo loader reads it. The exact place is not verified here; Tuesday will ask the deploy seat for the plain steps first. Then one read-only seller check runs and MPSCALC-395 closes.

options.label: Someone I name will renew it
options.detail: Give Tuesday the name. That person needs the right to change app secrets in that tenant. Same steps as above.

options.label: Leave it expired
options.detail: Every MPS deploy keeps skipping the three seller checks and asks you the same question each time. The 7 percent rebate default stays unchecked on the live site.

default: Nothing happens. The secret stays expired. The next MPS deploy card asks you the same question a third time.
detail:
Read at source 2026-11-19 17:04 to 17:10 AEDT by drafter A (read-only; no az, no host request).
VERIFIED
1. MPSCALC-395 (Backlog, label records-pass-1112, updated 2026-11-16 15:53): the hosted showcase's seed identity's client secret has expired (AADSTS7000222); the ticket's own recommendation: 'Renew the secret (an Entra write for the product owner or a holder of that grant; this ticket does not renew anything), then run the read-only Seller check once.' Comment 41292 (2026-11-16): still expired at 11:25 AEDT that day (token request HTTP 401 invalid_client, error 7000222), relayed from the deploy record; ruled a (1116 card, 10:25:36) 'Deploy without the three seller checks again; renew the secret separately'.
2. What the secret is for (ticket text): the demo loader (tools/demo/seed.py, client-credentials path takes the secret from the identity's settings) and the three after-deploy seller reads: the quote list (11 quotes expected), the figures read (GET /quotes/figures, which is a rollback trigger in the release rules) and the inventory, plus the Seller 403 on feedback and the diff-route rows. It also stands between us and checking the 7 percent rebate default for a caller without pricing rights (MPSCALC-160).
3. C-165 says the renewal 'is not done and is not ruled further here' and 'is an Entra write, the product owner's or a holder of that grant'. C-145 (2026-11-12) and C-166 (2026-11-16) record the secret expired at both deploys.
4. What rights any agent identity holds over that secret: not checked (no az allowed). C-165 says only that the renewal is an Entra write, 'the product owner's or a holder of that grant'.
REPORTED, UNVERIFIED
- That the secret is still expired today: last measured 2026-11-16 11:25 AEDT; no later reading.
- The exact portal path and where the new secret value must be stored: the ticket says the loader takes it from the identity's settings; I did not read the hosted settings. The deploy seat has the exact step; ask it before he does anything.
- Which tenant and which app registration: C-13 names the showcase tenant only as ec01829b-... (truncated); not verified here.
prior: decision_queue.sh prior (id mps-seed-secret-renewal-1119): the same two ruled cards as the deploy card: mpscalc-deploy-seed-secret-expired-1112 (a, 2026-11-12 18:36) and mpscalc-deploy-seed-secret-again-1116 (a, 2026-11-16 10:25:36). Both ruled 'deploy without the checks; renew the secret separately'. CLARIFICATIONS.md C-165 lines 3298 to 3308: 'The renewal is the separate task the option names: it is not done and is not ruled further here.' No ruling says who renews it or by when. My reading: he ruled that it is a separate task; nobody has been asked who does it. This is a card about who and when.
